description: Validate the HTTPS URL and adapter configuration for an external custom model. For OpenAI-compatible mode provide baseUrl; for custom REST use endpoint. Set probe=true only when an actual minimal request to the external provider is intended. Returns validation or probe status; credentials are transient and never stored or echoed. Requires active trial or Pro; does not perform a user prompt Send.

apiKey.description: Optional transient API credential, never stored or echoed.

apiKeyHeader.description: Header name when using api-key-header authentication.

authMode.description: Custom REST authentication method: bearer, API-key header, or none.

baseUrl.description: Public HTTPS base URL for openai-compatible mode.

endpoint.description: Full public HTTPS URL for custom-rest mode.

model.description: Optional external model identifier for a test probe.

probe.description: True sends a minimal external request to test the model; false only checks URL safety.

promptField.description: JSON request field for test prompt content on custom REST endpoints.

responseTextPath.description: JSON response field or path holding the generated text.

systemField.description: JSON request field for system instructions on custom REST endpoints.

name: validate_custom_model
title: Validate a custom model endpoint
